title: Diversify Your Datasets: Analyzing Generalization via Controlled Variance in Adversarial Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Testing Natural Language Inference (NLI) models on datasets controlled and split by syntactic complexity (sentence length and parse tree depth) to measure model over-reliance on simple syntactic structures.

Varying specific lexical items (e.g., dative verbs and specific numerical ranges) between training and test sets to evaluate if models memorize vocabulary artifacts rather than generalizing underlying inference rules.
